summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of PlacementHub enterprise iteration 2. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases pass (verification gating, admin verification+notification, recruiter approval, Cloudinary signature+document upload+admin verify, eligibility endpoint+ineligible-block, freeze/unfreeze, offer auto-creation on selection+accept-places+auto-freeze+dream-company exception, notification center+mark-all-read, RBAC for placement_officer & department_coordinator, staff CRUD, audit logs, admin/students advanced filters, extended admin stats, AI review + recommendations via Claude). Frontend Playwright: student sidebar has new items (AI Insights, Offers, Documents, Browse Jobs, My Applications, My Profile); notification bell present; AI Insights page renders run-ai-review-btn; Admin sidebar shows Staff & Roles + Audit Logs; AdminStudents renders filter-verification/filter-frozen/student-search + manage-student-<id> buttons opening student-manage-dialog; audit logs table has 10+ rows; coordinator sidebar hides Staff & Roles AND Audit Logs (RBAC); approved company shows no approval-banner; dark mode toggle works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1374 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Split into routers: auth, jobs, applications, offers, documents, admin_verification, admin_staff, admin_analytics, ai, notifications, plus a seed module.

Admin dashboard endpoint /api/admin/stats loops all students in-memory and executes N document-status counts + 6 monthly count_documents calls sequentially per request — will not scale. Use aggregation pipelines and $facet.
Duplicate CORS wildcard + allow_credentials=True (env CORS_ORIGINS='*') — browsers ignore credentials with wildcard; enterprise release should pin explicit origins.
auth cookie hardcoded secure=True + samesite='none' — fine for HTTPS preview but breaks local http testing; derive from env.

eligibility_check compares job['degree'] via .lower(), but graduation_year comparison is strict equality — a student in the year 2025 targeting a 2026 role will be flagged as ineligible even if that's intended; document this expectation clearly in UI.

delete_job returns 403 for admin without moderate_jobs perm AFTER already validating role — the check should also apply to admin PATCH /jobs/{id}/status; currently department_coordinator (has no 'moderate_jobs') is still blocked at require_perm? Actually PATCH status uses require_roles('company','admin') without perm gating, so a department_coordinator admin can close any job. Consider gating admin job status changes via 'moderate_jobs' perm.

profile_completion buckets 15 checks including 'Department' and 'Skills'/'Projects' — the mandatory_profile_ok requires 'department' NOT (only branch/degree/etc.) — but the seed does set department. Newly-registered students won't be able to apply until they set 'department' too, yet the UI mandatory list may not surface this clearly. mandatory_profile_ok actually checks MANDATORY_FIELDS which does NOT include department, but profile_completion penalises it — mismatch OK but confusing.
AI endpoints fall back to a heuristic for recommendations if Claude fails, but ai-review raises 502 — inconsistent. Consider a deterministic scoring fallback for ai-review too.
No input length caps on job title/description, staff name, profile bio, remarks — potential abuse.
cloudinary_signature always signs (folder, timestamp) but not resource_type — client must remember to POST with matching folder; consider signing all upload params explicitly.
Notifications endpoint returns up to 100 items unpaginated — no cursor/skip. Fine short-term but should paginate.

trend calculation still uses date-string range on `created_at` (ISO) — works because ISO strings sort lexicographically, but relies on all rows storing UTC ISO. Any legacy record with mismatched TZ format would corrupt trend counts.

AI endpoints call Claude live (~5-10s each) — expect real latency. Post-login navigation goes through role-based redirects inside DashboardLayout.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no issues found. All enterprise features (verification, RBAC, freeze, offer/placement policy incl. dream-company exception, documents, eligibility, AI, staff, audit, filters, extended stats, notifications) function correctly end-to-end at both API and UI layers.
